programs.name: bhedtopar
programs.purpose: Convert a binary SEG-Y tape header into an ASCII parameter file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: BHEDTOPAR - convert a Binary tape HEaDer file to PAR file format

params.name: swap
params.description: Swap the bytes of each binary-header value.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Binary-header representation and byte order depend on the SUXDR build and swap option.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program reads one binary header and prints its fields.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | segyhdrs bfile=binary hfile=header > /dev/null && bhedtopar outpar=header.par < binary
suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | segyhdrs bfile=binary hfile=header > /dev/null && bhedtopar swap=1 outpar=swapped.par < binary

programs.name: su3dchart
programs.purpose: Write source-receiver midpoint coordinate pairs as binary floats.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SU3DCHART - plot x-midpoints vs. y-midpoints for 3-D data

params.name: degree
params.description: Convert coordinates in seconds of arc to degrees when counit is 2.

params.name: outpar
params.description: Optional file receiving the number of coordinate pairs.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Coordinates and scaling are calculated in double precision and converted to float for output.
programs.difficulty_reason: Each output pair is calculated independently from one trace header.

test_cases.description: Write midpoint pairs and a count file.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sushw key=sx,gx,sy,gy a=100,200,300,400 | su3dchart outpar=count.par > midpoints.bin

test_cases.description: Convert scaled angular coordinates to degrees.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sushw key=sx,gx,sy,gy,scalco,counit a=3600,7200,10800,14400,-10,2 | su3dchart degree=1 > degrees.bin

programs.name: suabshw
programs.purpose: Replace a selected trace-header value with its absolute value.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUABSHW - replace header key word by its absolute value
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Negating the minimum signed integer can overflow; unsigned values are left unchanged.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program changes one header value independently for each trace.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sushw key=offset a=-100 b=50 | suabshw key=offset

test_cases.description: Take absolute values of another signed header.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sushw key=sx a=-200 b=50 | suabshw key=sx

programs.name: suaddhead
programs.purpose: Attach SU trace headers to bare floating-point sample arrays.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUADDHEAD - put headers on bare traces and set the tracl and ns fields

params.name: n1
params.description: Samples per trace; takes precedence over nt and ns. One of these three aliases is required.

params.name: nt
params.description: Samples per trace; an alternative to n1 and ns. One of these three aliases is required.

params.name: ns
params.description: Samples per trace; an alternative to n1 and nt. One of these three aliases is required.

params.name: ftn
params.description: Set to 1 to skip Fortran record markers.

params.name: ntrpr
params.description: Traces per record for the optional line header.

params.name: tsort
params.description: Sorting code for the optional line header.

params.name: head
params.description: Input header file, available only when compiled with SU_LINE_HEADER.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Input floats use the native binary representation; Fortran record markers are skipped without validating their values.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program adds headers to fixed-length arrays of samples.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sustrip > bare.bin && suaddhead ns=32 ftn=0 < bare.bin

test_cases.description: Use the nt alias and non-default line-header settings.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=3 | sustrip > bare.bin && suaddhead nt=64 tsort=2 ntrpr=3 < bare.bin

programs.license_note: Credits include SEP and UNOCAL contributions.

programs.name: suahw
programs.purpose: Assign a header value from a table indexed by another header value.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUAHW - Assign Header Word using another header word

params.name: mode
params.description: Behavior for values absent from the table: extrapolate, interpolate, zero, preserve, or transfer.

params.name: key3
params.description: Header word used with the optional c filter.

params.name: b
params.description: Strictly ascending input table values; must have the same length as a.

params.name: c
params.description: Optional values or range used to filter modifications by key3.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Interpolation uses double arithmetic before conversion to the destination header type.
programs.difficulty_reason: It supports several table lookup and interpolation modes with an additional header filter.

test_cases.description: Interpolate a header from a two-point table.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sushw key=fldr a=1 b=1 | suahw key1=ep key2=fldr a=10,40 b=1,4 mode=interpolate

test_cases.description: Set unmatched values to zero while filtering on a third header.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sushw key=fldr,tracf a=1,1 b=1,1 | suahw key1=ep key2=fldr key3=tracf a=10,30 b=1,3 c=2 mode=zero

programs.license_note: Credits say the program was cloned from suchw by Einar Kjartansson, SEP.

programs.name: suazimuth
programs.purpose: Calculate azimuth and optionally offset and midpoint coordinates from trace headers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUAZIMUTH - compute trace AZIMUTH, offset, and midpoint coordinates
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Double-precision coordinate calculations use transcendental functions and square root before conversion to header types; signed-offset selection casts coordinate differences to float.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program computes independent coordinate-derived header values for each trace.

test_cases.description: Calculate azimuth, signed offset, and midpoint.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sushw key=sx,sy,gx,gy a=100,200,300,500 | suazimuth az=1 offset=1 signedflag=1 cmp=1

test_cases.description: Calculate reverse-direction azimuth sectors in another header.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sushw key=sx,sy,gx,gy a=100,200,300,500 | suazimuth az=-1 sector=10 key=ep scale=2

programs.license_note: Credits state that the program is based on suchw and su3dchart and include UTulsa and RISSC contributions.
